task_message:
Case N13: segment the peripheral nerve sheath tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 161x161x197 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Segmentation complete for case N13.

**Result:** Peripheral nerve sheath tumor of the right thigh segmented (v2, 73.3 mL, single component).

**Workflow:**
1. `seg_open` + sagittal/axial sheets located the large T2-hyperintense fusiform mass spanning ~87 mm along the thigh (axial 35–122), maximal at the mid-thigh.
2. Two positive point prompts on the lesion core (axial 88, marks 318/305) produced a clean initial mask (v1) capturing the bright mass.
3. Verified the mask on multiple axial (36, 41, 45, 55, 112, 116, 122, 125), coronal (60, 76, 86, 93), and sagittal (70, 93, 105, 115) slices — the outline followed the tumor boundary, with no leaks into the vessels or bone.
4. `seg_candidates` proposed one small (0.5 mL) superior-margin rim region (C1), consistent with the tumor's less intense periphery; accepted it (v2). A second candidate query returned nothing.
5. Final five-slice-per-plane review confirmed no lesion tissue beyond either end of the mask and no stray components; saved with high confidence.
